Gauntlet

scroll · the record↓
the premise

Fifty scenarios, a sealed world, and tools that fail on purpose. The agent is not asked how it would behave. It is made to behave, and the trajectory is kept.

Every scenario runs against a fresh copy of the world. Faults are injected on a schedule — timeouts, garbage payloads, rate limits — so recovery is measured, not assumed.

Deterministic graders score tool selection, arguments, efficiency, recovery, world state and the final answer. A judge model is consulted last, and only where code cannot decide.
